note: Moonbot Placo + continuous move_js, Xnero body/shoulder mapping, Pico/XRoboToolkit input. Default remains right arm can0; add --dual for right can0/right hand plus left can1/left hand. Head forward/up/right at Grip -> robot body forward/up/right, independent of TCP orientation, 1:1 plus controller orientation, 75 Hz, 400 mm/s TCP, 120 deg/s joint and 60 deg/s orientation ceilings, 2 deg joint steps. These are host settings, not verified hardware maximum speeds. JS bypasses firmware trajectory smoothing; its speed is bounded in the host. Input loss holds and requires fresh release/regrip. Startup and each controller secondary button return the corresponding arm to home_poses.json at separate bounded speeds; no shutdown return or zero calibration. Factory model limits retained; physical tracking performance requires live validation. Use deployment_legacy.json for previous behavior.
